name: Rice-paper rolls with boiled pork
nameVi: Bánh tráng cuốn thịt heo luộc
summary: Thin slices of boiled or steamed belly pork, lean and fat together, rolled in local rice paper with lettuce, herbs, cucumber, and green banana. The dip is a fish sauce made from cá cơm, cá sặc, and cá thu.
origin: Phu Yen. The rice paper is made in three villages.
howToEat: Roll the pork with the greens and dip each roll. It is served to guests, at parties, and at breakfast.
where: The rice paper comes from Hoà Đa in xã An Mỹ, Đông Bình in xã Hoà An, and Phường Lụa in thị trấn Chí Thạnh.
seoTitle: Rice-paper rolls with boiled pork — three Phu Yen villages
seoDescription: Boiled belly pork in Phu Yen rice paper with greens and green banana, dipped in a three-fish sauce.
